old_description: Hemeixin Electronics Co., Limited is one quick-turn manufacturer of prototype, various types and low volume PCBs in the world; to offer personalized one-stop solution matching the local various types and quick turn
about:
Hemeixin Electronics Co., Ltd is headquartered in San Jose, California, with its own state-of-the-art PCB fabrication facilities in China. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It was established to provide quick-turn prototype, low-volume, and production printed circuit boards with a personalized one-stop service model.

The company manufactures rigid, flexible, and rigid-flex PCBs, including high-density interconnect (HDI) boards up to 58 layers, high-frequency and microwave circuits, heavy copper designs up to 30 oz, and boards with blind/buried vias, microvias, via-in-pad, cavity structures, and back drilling. It also offers in-house PCB assembly (SMT, through-hole, turnkey, consigned) and design-for-manufacturability checks. Standard lead times are advertised as fast as 72 hours for quick-turn orders, with full turnkey service within five days.

Hemeixin serves customers in portable communications, networking equipment, high-speed digital, and RF/microwave applications. Its materials portfolio includes polyimide (Kapton), PET, PEN, LCP, and a wide range of low-loss and high-speed laminates from Isola, Rogers, Arlon, Taconic, and Panasonic. The company's capabilities target designs requiring fine-line traces down to 0.002 inch, BGA pitches to 0.15 mm, and impedance control within ±5%.

The business emphasizes its integrated fabrication and assembly under one roof, a clean factory environment, and an online quoting system that delivers instant pricing for prototypes through volume production.
